verdict.rationale: Numeral documents a general integrations page claiming native integrations for billing/commerce platforms that feed transactions in automatically for tax calc and filing (doc-8, doc-31), plus API endpoints for merchants/platform transactions covering marketplace and payment-processor flows (doc-23, doc-24, doc-25). However, no specific named integrations (e.g., Stripe, Shopify, specific billing systems) are listed or evidenced, and there's no independent confirmation of integration breadth or reliability. Missing for 10: named/maintained third-party integration list, evidence of integration maintenance/versioning, independent corroboration of real-world integration usage.
